Conditional regressors HGB squared loss, negative goals/assists/CS clipped. Other-point residual preserves exact historic target accounting, including scoring changes.
goal_weights: Fixed bookkeeping weights GK6 DEF6 MID5 FWD4; residual absorbs any historical-rule differences. Not a current-rule rescore.
